notes: DRAFT for M7-P3 (tutorial lines for the P2 tutorial floor). Same format and keys as content/tutorial/sensei-lessons.json. One screen line per step, each under 12 words; 'success' shows when the step is done; 'retry'/'nudge' only on the brute step (never a penalty, Health never drops below 1). 'COUNTER' matches the button label. The P4 cascade line 'You've already earned these in the dojo.' is in the plan's own spec and isn't repeated here. Played once per profile; replay from the Lesson Scroll.
speaker: sensei

lessons.trigger: Tutorial floor starts: bow at the door
screens: Bow at the door to show respect.
Tap where you want to go, or use the stick.

lessons.trigger: Slow brute appears and winds up (game slows, COUNTER pulses)
lessons.retry: Almost! The circle will come again.
lessons.nudge: Take your time. Tap the blue COUNTER button!

screens: Pick one Insight. It helps for this climb.
A treasure chest! Walk up to open it.
A bigger foe. Watch the circles, like before.
